description: Victorian Public Dams and Retarding Basins - Unrestricted is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. This dataset represents public dams and retarding basins in Victoria. The dataset is a point dataset. This is the unrestricted version of the data for display on the DEECA public website. For Water Corporations, Parks Victoria and AGL Hydro, this data is an extract from the FloodZoom Dams Portal used for annual dam safety reporting. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Its tags are Environment, Inland waters. It offers 9 resource(s) in DWG, DXF, EXTENDED TAB, GDB, MIF. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
